candidates.exact_span: A valid test for each species must be reported during each reporting period specified in PART I of this permit unless the permittee is performing a TRE which may increase the frequency of testing and reporting.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether monitoring was required for a given species and reporting period depends on PART I period definitions and whether a TRE exception applies; different readings change which obligations are in force and whether absent biomonitoring data reflects a missing-evidence case versus a period where frequency or applicability differed.

candidates.exact_span: One set of biomonitoring data for each species is to be recorded on the DMR for each reporting period. Additional results are reported under the retest codes below.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Interpretation of how many DMR entries are required per species per period, and whether supplemental results belong on primary DMR lines or retest codes, changes which monitoring obligations were satisfied and how missing or extra reported values are classified.

candidates.exact_span: Only results of valid tests are to be reported on the DMR.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether a test is deemed valid versus invalid determines whether a DMR absence is a documented no-data state, required monitoring lacking adequate evidence, or an expected outcome when only invalid tests occurred.

candidates.exact_span: For any test which fails, is considered invalid, or which is terminated early for any reason, the full report must be submitted for agency review.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Failed, invalid, or early-terminated tests trigger a separate full-report obligation distinct from DMR reporting; different classification of a test changes what evidence should exist and how missing ordinary DMR results are interpreted.

candidates.exact_span: The permittee shall prepare a full report of the results of all tests conducted pursuant to this part in accordance with the Report Preparation Section of the most current publication of the method manual, for every valid or invalid toxicity test initiated, whether carried to completion or not.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Tests initiated but not completed still generate a full-report evidence obligation; whether an initiated-but-incomplete test counts as conducted affects whether missing DMR data is explained by invalid/incomplete status or remains unresolved.

candidates.exact_span: Submit retest information clearly marked as such with the following month's DMR.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Retest results are tied to the subsequent monthly DMR rather than the original reporting period; different timing interpretation changes which period's monitoring obligation is satisfied and whether a given period lacks evidence or is covered by a later submission.

candidates.exact_span: Enter a "1" if the No Observed Effect Concentration (NOEC) for survival is less than the critical dilution, otherwise enter a "0".
candidates.computation_change_reason: This binary reporting rule encodes a compliance comparison between measured NOEC and the critical dilution; different readings of NOEC, critical dilution, or the less-than test change whether the applicable limit comparison is exceeded.

candidates.exact_span: Report the NOEC value for survival
candidates.computation_change_reason: The reported NOEC is the measurement used in the survival comparison against critical dilution; interpretation of which NOEC value applies or how it is derived changes limit-exceedance evaluation and whether the numeric reporting obligation was met.

candidates.exact_span: Report the highest (critical dilution or control) Coefficient of Variation
candidates.computation_change_reason: Selection between critical dilution and control when determining the highest coefficient of variation affects both the numeric value reported and downstream validity or interpretation of the NOEC-versus-critical-dilution comparison.
